statement: The source three-qubit commuting dephasing example remains PPT across every partial transpose at every time yet has a negative exact finite-time entanglement witness. A quantum-bus channel construction supplies explicit primitives and costs.

evidence.quote: ## 3. An explicit purely dissipative counterexample to all partial-transpose diagnostics
evidence.range_scope: Native partial-prefix section containing the purely dissipative all-PPT example, exact reported witness and quantum-bus resources.

requires: Three qubits, n_i=(I-Z_i)/2, U=0 and C=L L^dagger+(19/10)I with rows of L equal to [1+2i,1+2i],[-1,-2],[2i,-2+i]. Start |+>^tensor3.

The source rational partial-transpose generator certificates, dual witness and exact Taylor remainder; full certificate matrices are in the unacquired package, not reconstructed from a small floating-point eigenvalue.
provides: Every partial transpose stays positive for every time. At t=1/35727 the source certifies witness expectation<-1.1912394e-7. No coherent interparty Hamiltonian is present.

For each column v use a fresh vacuum oscillator and controlled displacement with L_v=sum_i v_i n_i. The symmetric sequence exp(B1)...exp(Bm)exp(Bm)...exp(B1), B_i=(sqrt(h)/2)n_i(v_i b^dagger-v_i^*b), cancels central geometric phases. Two independent buses and local classical phase noise implement the displayed C.
